sourceSpans.quote:
Elena Voss: I will publish the final rollback runbook by 2026-08-05.
Marcus Lee: That runbook should include the normal rollback boundary and a link to the incident channel.

items.action: Reconcile accessibility matrix against approved scope

sourceSpans.quote:
Talia Brooks: I will reconcile the accessibility matrix against the approved scope by 2026-08-06.
Jon Bell: The approved scope is the signed appendix, not the unlabeled spreadsheet in the shared folder.
Ravi Desai: I will configure the installer telemetry alert set by 2026-08-07.

Ravi Desai: Correction to my installer telemetry commitment: move its due date from 2026-08-07 to 2026-08-10; I still own it.
Elena Voss: That is the final date for the telemetry work, and the earlier date is superseded.

items.condition: Penetration-test retest is green (signed result, not informal message)

sourceSpans.quote:
Sophie Turner: I will approve the security exception by 2026-08-08 only if the penetration-test retest is green; until then this item is conditional.
Imani Ross: A green retest means the signed result, not an informal message from the testing vendor.
Caleb Ng: I will draft the customer-facing support brief by 2026-08-07.

Imani Ross: Imani Ross will own the customer-facing support brief instead of Caleb Ng, with the same due date 2026-08-07; Caleb Ng is released.
Caleb Ng: Confirmed: I am released from the brief, while I remain available for questions without owning delivery.
Marcus Lee: I will package the release candidate build by 2026-08-10; it is blocked until the signing service returns to service.

items.action: Record final launch decision and distribute signed decision log

sourceSpans.quote:
Jon Bell: I will record the final launch decision and distribute the signed decision log; there is no fixed due date.
Imani Ross: The decision log records the outcome but does not itself assign every follow-up mentioned during discussion.

Sophie Turner: I will complete the launch-blocking signing-key audit by 2026-08-10.
Elena Voss: The audit is explicitly launch-blocking, so flag it as critical rather than inferring criticality from urgency.

Ravi Desai: Release Operations will verify the overnight escalation roster by 2026-08-11.
Ravi Desai: That team name is the accountable owner; individual on-call rotations can change without changing the action.

Talia Brooks: After the review, I will archive the reconciled evidence bundle by 2026-08-12.
Talia Brooks: This archive is separate from the completed prototype folder and will use the final naming convention.

Caleb Ng: I will publish the customer-blocking support escalation matrix by 2026-08-11.
Caleb Ng: Customer-blocking is explicit because launch cannot proceed without the support escalation path.

Jon Bell: I will circulate the final ownership table by 2026-08-12.
Imani Ross: The ownership table should reflect the reassignment and omit the withdrawn training session.

ambiguities.note: Marcus Lee: 'I can probably take care of the fallback review soon' is materially ambiguous—no explicit commitment, no definite due date, and unclear ownership status. Per line 51, recorded as ambiguous rather than action item.
